info.title: Zeno API
info.description:
Everything the web app, the extension and the studio ask the API.

Errors always look like `{"error": {"code", "message", "fields"?}}`; branch on `code`. Browsers send `Origin`, and state-changing requests from any other origin are refused with `403 forbidden_origin`.

get.summary: The signed-in user's own recent security activity, newest first.

post.summary: Changes the password of the signed-in account, and signs it out everywhere.
post.description:
The current password is asked for again, so a session someone else holds is not enough to take the account over.
Five tries an hour per account. On success every session of the account ends, this one included, and so does
every viewing it had open: the cookies are cleared and the person signs in again with the new password.

200.description: Changed. Every session is over; sign in again.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `wrong_password`: that is not the current password, or `forbidden_origin`.

422.description: `validation_failed` (see `fields`: the new password is not allowed, or is the current one) or `invalid_request`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

post.summary: Emails a password reset link, if the account exists.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `forbidden_origin`: the request came from a site that is not the web app.

422.description: `validation_failed` (see `fields`) or `invalid_request` (the JSON has the wrong shape or an unknown field).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

post.summary: Signs in with an email and password.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

401.description: `invalid_credentials`: the same answer for an unknown email and a wrong password.

403.description: `email_not_verified` (the password was right but the address is not confirmed) or `forbidden_origin`.

422.description: `invalid_request`: valid JSON, but not the shape this route takes (or an unknown field).

429.description: `too_many_requests`: too many failures for this email or address.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

post.summary: Ends this session and clears the cookies. Safe to repeat.

403.description: `forbidden_origin`: the request came from a site that is not the web app.

401.description: `unauthenticated`: no session, or it expired. Refresh and retry once.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `forbidden_origin`: the request came from a site that is not the web app.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

post.summary: Rotates the session. Reads the refresh cookie; sends no body and returns none.
post.description:
A refresh token is single-use. If two tabs refresh at once, one gets `401 refresh_conflict`
and should simply retry.

204.description: A new pair of cookies was set.

401.description: `unauthenticated` (no cookie), `refresh_conflict` (retry shortly) or `session_expired` (the cookies are cleared; sign in again).

403.description: `forbidden_origin`: the request came from a site that is not the web app.

post.summary: Creates an account and emails a link to verify it.
post.description:
The answer is the same whether or not the email was already registered, so this cannot be used
to find out who has an account.

202.description: Accepted. A link is on its way if the address can be used.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `forbidden_origin`: the request came from a site that is not the web app.

422.description: `validation_failed` (every invalid field at once, in `fields`) or `invalid_request` (the JSON has the wrong shape or an unknown field).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

503.description: `unavailable`: the limiter is down, and this route fails closed.

post.summary: Sends a new verification link, if the account exists and still needs one.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `forbidden_origin`: the request came from a site that is not the web app.

422.description: `validation_failed` (see `fields`) or `invalid_request` (the JSON has the wrong shape or an unknown field).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

post.summary: Sets a new password with the one-time token from the reset link, and ends every other session.

200.description: Password updated. The person signs in again.

400.description: `invalid_token` (the link is wrong, used or expired) or `invalid_request` (a malformed body).

403.description: `forbidden_origin`: the request came from a site that is not the web app.

422.description: `validation_failed` (the new password is not allowed) or `invalid_request` (the JSON has the wrong shape).

post.summary: Confirms an email address with the one-time token from the link, and signs the person in.

400.description: `invalid_token` (the link is wrong, used or expired) or `invalid_request` (a malformed body).

403.description: `forbidden_origin`: the request came from a site that is not the web app.

422.description: `invalid_request`: valid JSON, but not the shape this route takes (or an unknown field).

delete.summary:
Removes a comment or a reaction: its author may, and so may the owner of the recording it is on.
For anyone else it does not exist.

403.description: `forbidden_origin`

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

post.summary: Accepts an invitation, with the token from the emailed link.
post.description:
The caller must be signed in as the account that has the address the invitation was sent to, verified. A link
that is wrong, used, revoked or out of time is one answer (`invalid_token`): nothing says which.

200.description: Joined (or already in it). The workspace, with the role the caller now has.

400.description: `invalid_token`: wrong, used, revoked, expired, or its workspace is gone.

403.description: `wrong_account`: the invitation was sent to another address, or this one is not verified; or `forbidden_origin`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

get.summary: How much of their storage the signed-in person has used.

200.description: Used, allowed and left, in bytes.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

delete.summary: Ends the viewing. Safe to call on one that has already ended.

403.description: `forbidden_origin`

post.summary: Says the viewing is still going, and where it is. Send it every `heartbeat_interval_seconds`.
post.description:
This is also where a viewing finds out it is over: the answer is `409 session_ended` when it was closed
(the access it rested on has gone, it was started on another screen, or it ran out), and the body says why.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `forbidden_origin`: the request came from a site that is not the web app.

409.description: `session_ended`: it is over, and the message says why. Start another to watch more.

422.description: `invalid_request`: valid JSON, but not the shape this route takes (or an unknown field).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

get.summary: The caller's library, newest first, a page at a time.

400.description: `invalid_cursor`

403.description: `forbidden`: only creator and admin accounts keep a library.

422.description: `validation_failed`: `source` is not one the API knows.

post.summary: Makes a recording in the caller's library.
post.description:
`201` when this call made it; `200` when it found the one an earlier attempt with the same `id`
made, so a retry after a dropped connection never makes a duplicate.

200.description: Already made by an earlier attempt with this `id`.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `forbidden` (only creator and admin accounts keep a library) or `forbidden_origin`.

404.description: `video_not_found`: `video_id` is not one of your uploads.

409.description: `id_conflict` (the id is taken by something else) or `video_in_use` (that video already belongs to another recording).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

get.summary: One recording. Someone else's, a deleted one and a malformed id all answer `404`.

403.description: `forbidden`: only creator and admin accounts keep a library.

delete.summary:
Deletes a recording, and its video unless a course still uses it. Every link to it stops
working at once.

403.description: `forbidden` or `forbidden_origin`.

patch.summary: Renames a recording or changes who may watch it.
patch.description:
Optimistic: say which `version` you read, in the body or in `If-Match`. If it has moved on, the
answer is `409 version_conflict` and nothing changes.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The version you read, instead of `version` in the body.

400.description: `invalid_version`, `version_mismatch` or `invalid_request`.

403.description: `forbidden` or `forbidden_origin`.

409.description: `version_conflict`: it changed since you read it. Reload and try again.

get.summary: The conversation on one of the caller's own recordings, newest first, whether or not it is open to others.

parameters.name: t
parameters.description: For a link with a password: the token of a viewing that unlocked it (the `t` of its playlist address).

200.description: One page. `comments_enabled` says whether others can see and add to it.

400.description: `invalid_cursor`

403.description: `forbidden`: only creator and admin accounts keep a library.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

get.summary: The recording's links, newest first, whether they still work or not. Never carries a password.

403.description: `forbidden`

post.summary:
Makes a share link for a recording. A private recording is switched to `link` in the same
call: a link to something nobody may see would be a trap.

201.description: Made, or returned the same open link for a repeated client `id` and the same details. `link.url` is what to hand out.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `forbidden` or `forbidden_origin`.

409.description: `too_many_links` or `link_id_conflict`: a recording may have 10 live links, and an id cannot be reused for another or closed link.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

delete.summary: Revokes a link and ends every viewing under way through it. Safe to repeat.

403.description: `forbidden` or `forbidden_origin`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

get.summary: What a visitor's page needs before anyone presses play.
get.description:
Public and cacheable: an edge may reuse the answer for 15 seconds and serve it stale for 45
more while it fetches a fresh one, so the origin hears about a link about four times a minute
however many people open it. A cached answer never lets anyone watch after a revoke: playing
asks the database again. While the video is not ready the answer is reused for 2 seconds only (see
`CACHE_CONTROL_WAITING`), so a page waiting for it to play finds out at once.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The 22 characters after `/s/` in the link.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: The `ETag` of an answer already held.

Cache-Control.description: `public, max-age=15, stale-while-revalidate=45`; `public, max-age=2` while the video is not ready yet.

ETag.description: A weak validator over the body.

304.description: The caller already holds this exact answer.

404.description: `not_found`: no such link (a code of the wrong shape never reaches the database).

410.description: `link_unavailable`: the link was good and has closed (revoked, expired, switched off, or its recording deleted).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

get.summary: The conversation on a shared recording, newest first, a page at a time.
get.description:
Open to anyone who can watch: no account is needed to read. For a link with a password, only a viewing that
unlocked it may (pass the `t` of its playlist address). Never cached: it carries what the asker may delete.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The 22 characters after `/s/` in the link.

parameters.name: t
parameters.description: For a link with a password: the token of a viewing that unlocked it (the `t` of its playlist address).

200.description: One page. With comments turned off it is empty and says so.

400.description: `invalid_cursor`

403.description: `password_required`: the link has a password and this is not a viewing that gave it.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

post.summary: Leaves a comment or a reaction on a shared recording.
post.description:
Needs a signed-in account (any), and a link that is open to the asker, as for reading. Sending the same
`id` and content again returns the comment that was left instead of a second one.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The 22 characters after `/s/` in the link.

parameters.name: t
parameters.description: For a link with a password: the token of a viewing that unlocked it.

201.description: Left (or already left, for a repeated `id`).

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `password_required` or `forbidden_origin`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

post.summary: Starts watching through a link: checks the password if there is one, then opens a session.
post.description:
`playback.playlist_url` is relative to this origin and is handed to the HLS player as it is.
There is no heartbeat and no resume point: there is no account to remember either for.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The 22 characters after `/s/` in the link.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `password_required`, `wrong_password` (a guess costs a password hash, so guesses are limited per link and address), or `forbidden_origin`.

409.description: `not_ready`: the video is still being prepared.

410.description: `link_unavailable`: the link has closed, including a moment ago.

422.description: `invalid_request`: valid JSON, but not the shape this route takes (or an unknown field).

429.description: `too_many_requests`: too many viewings started from this address, or too many password guesses.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

post.summary: Starts the upload of a recording that is still being made.
post.description:
There is no size to give. Parts are asked for one at a time as they fill (`POST /v1/videos/{id}/parts`),
each URL signed for exactly the length said, and the size is stated at the end
(`POST /v1/videos/{id}/complete`). Nothing the client sends reaches this API: the bytes go to storage.

201.description: Started, or returned the same still-open upload for a repeated client `id`. `upload.parts` is empty: ask for each part as it fills.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `forbidden` (only creator and admin accounts upload) or `forbidden_origin`.

409.description: `streaming_id_conflict`: that client id belongs to a different or finished upload.

413.description: `storage_quota_exceeded`: the account has no storage left (`GET /v1/me/storage` says how much it has), or `payload_too_large`.

429.description: `too_many_uploads` (ten are unfinished: finish or abort one) or `too_many_requests` (which carries `Retry-After`).

post.summary:
Finishes an upload. A recording's upload says how big the recording came to; a file's has nothing to say
(its size was given at the start), so its request has no body.
post.description:
Storage is asked what it holds before anything is assembled: if a part is missing the answer is
`409 upload_incomplete` and nothing is queued. Completing twice is not an error.

requestBody.description: Required for a recording's upload; not sent for a file's.

200.description: Assembled, and queued for processing (or already was).

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `forbidden` or `forbidden_origin`.

409.description: `upload_incomplete` (the message says which parts are missing), `upload_expired`, `not_uploading`, `video_failed` or `size_mismatch`.

422.description: `validation_failed`: `size_bytes` is missing, zero, over the limit, or not the size a file's upload was started with.

post.summary: The URL for one more part of a recording's upload, signed for exactly its length.
post.description:
Asking again for a part gives a fresh URL: a client that lost the answer, or whose URL expired,
just asks. Every part but the last is exactly the part size; the last is 1 up to the part size.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `forbidden` or `forbidden_origin`.

409.description: `not_streaming`: this upload is finished, or was started with a size.

413.description: `storage_quota_exceeded`: this part would take the recording past the account's storage. The recorder still has the whole recording; nothing is lost by this answer. Or `payload_too_large`.

422.description: `validation_failed` (see `fields`: the number or the size) or `invalid_request`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

post.summary:
Starts a viewing of a video: for its owner, an admin, or anyone in a workspace that holds a recording
made of it.
post.description:
Gives back the playlist address and what the player needs to keep the viewing alive. A student who is
enrolled in a course plays through the lesson instead, never through a video's own id. An account may
watch on a few screens at once; starting one more is `409 stream_limit`.

403.description: `playback_denied`: not yours, and not in a workspace that holds it; or `forbidden_origin`.

409.description: `not_ready` (still being processed) or `stream_limit` (already watching on as many screens as an account may).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

get.summary: What storage already holds of an upload, for a client that was interrupted.
get.description:
For a recording's upload (`POST /v1/videos/streaming`), `uploaded` lists the numbers of the parts storage
holds in full, that is, of exactly the part size the upload was started with: a shorter last part is not
listed, because it is only known to be the last once the recording has ended. `parts` is empty and
`total_parts` is 0, since the size is not known until the end: the client knows what it has, and asks for
each part it still needs with `POST /v1/videos/{id}/parts`. Asking changes nothing.

403.description: `forbidden` (only creator and admin accounts upload) or `forbidden_origin`.

409.description: `not_uploading`: the upload is finished or was aborted.

get.summary: The workspaces the caller is in, newest first, each with what they are in it.

200.description: All of them: nobody is in enough for a page to be needed.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

post.summary: Starts a workspace, with the caller as its owner.
post.description: An account may own five, and start ten an hour.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `forbidden_origin`: the request came from a site that is not the web app.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

get.summary: One workspace and the people in it.
get.description:
Owners and admins see every member's email address; a member sees names (and their own address). Somebody who
is not in the workspace gets `404`, as for one that does not exist.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

delete.summary: Ends the workspace for everyone in it. Owners only.
delete.description:
Its members lose access at once and its open invitations stop working. Nothing a member made on their own is
touched: it was never the workspace's.

403.description: `forbidden`: only an owner may, or `forbidden_origin`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

patch.summary: Renames the workspace. Owners and admins.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `forbidden`: a member may not, or `forbidden_origin`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

get.summary: The invitations still waiting for an answer. Owners and admins.

200.description: Newest first. Never carries the token.

403.description: `forbidden`: a member may not see them.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

post.summary: Invites somebody by email address.
post.description:
The email carries a link that works for seven days and only for the account that has that address, verified.
Owners invite admins and members; admins invite members. Twenty an hour, and a workspace holds fifty people
counting the invitations still open. The answer never says whether the address has an account.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `forbidden`: this role may not invite that one, or `forbidden_origin`.

409.description: `already_member`, `already_invited` (revoke the open one to send another) or `workspace_full`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

delete.summary: Takes an invitation back. Owners and admins. The link stops working at once.

403.description: `forbidden`: a member may not, or `forbidden_origin`.

404.description: `not_found`: no such workspace, or no such open invitation in it.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

delete.summary: Removes a member, or leaves (when `user` is the caller).
delete.description: Owners remove anyone; admins remove members. Anyone may leave, except the last owner.

403.description: `forbidden`: this role may not remove that one, or `forbidden_origin`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

patch.summary: Changes what somebody is in the workspace. Owners only.
patch.description: The last owner cannot be made anything else: a workspace always has one.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `forbidden`: only an owner may, or `forbidden_origin`.

409.description: `last_owner`: that would leave the workspace with none.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

get.summary: The recordings in the workspace, newest first, a page at a time.
get.description: Anyone in it can see this list and watch what is in it. Somebody who is not in the workspace gets `404`.

400.description: `invalid_cursor`

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

put.summary: Puts one of your recordings in the workspace, so everyone in it can see and watch it.
put.description:
It stays yours: you edit it, share it and delete it. A recording is in one workspace at a time, so putting it
in another moves it. Repeating the call changes nothing. A recording that is not yours, or is deleted, is
`404`, as is a workspace you are not in.

403.description: `forbidden_origin`

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

delete.summary: Takes a recording out of the workspace. It stays in its maker's library.
delete.description: Its maker may, and so may the workspace's owners and admins; a member may not take out somebody else's.

204.description: It is out. Viewings of it by the workspace's people end at their next request.

403.description: `forbidden`: a member may not take out somebody else's, or `forbidden_origin`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

token.description: The token in the emailed link.

current_password.description: The password in use now. Asked for again because a stolen session must not be enough to take the account.

new_password.description: Not a common password, not made from the account's email address, and not the one in use now.

comments_enabled.description: When off, the owner has closed the conversation: `comments` is empty and nobody can add to it.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last.

at_ms.description: Where in the video, in milliseconds.

can_delete.description: Whether the person asking may remove it: its author, or the owner of the recording.

CompleteRequest.description: How a streaming upload ends: the size the recording came to.

CreateCommentRequest.description: What a person leaves. A comment has `body`; a reaction has `emoji` and `at_ms`.

at_ms.description:
Where in the video, in milliseconds. Optional for a comment (without it, it is about the whole video),
required for a reaction. Not past the end of the video.

body.description: The words of a comment, 1 to 1000 characters.

emoji.description: One of the reactions on offer. Only for a reaction.

id.description:
Client-generated id for retrying a post whose response was lost: the same id with the same content
returns the same comment instead of a second one.

email.description: Where the invitation is sent. Only the account that has this address, verified, can accept it.

role.description: What they will be. `admin` or `member`: nobody is invited as an owner.

expires_at.description: From a minute to ten years from now. Without one the link never expires.

id.description: Client-generated id for retrying a link creation whose response was lost.

password.description: A speed bump for casual sharing, not an account. Checked before a viewing starts.

id.description:
A client-chosen id (a random UUID). Sending the same one again returns the recording the
first attempt made, so a retry after a dropped connection never makes a duplicate.

source.description: What produces the recording. Fixed for its life.

video_id.description: An upload of the caller's own to attach straight away.

CreateStreamingRequest.description: An upload of a recording that is still being made. There is no size to give: it is stated at the end.

id.description:
Client-generated id for retrying a start whose response was lost. Reuse it only for the
same recording; an existing id with different details is refused.

part_size_bytes.description:
How big each part is, from 5 to 64 MiB (default 16). Smaller means less to lose to one failed
request, larger means fewer requests.

name.description: 2 to 80 characters, trimmed. Not unique: two teams may be called the same.

code.description: Stable and machine-readable; branch on this, not on the message.

fields.description: Present on `422 validation_failed`: every invalid field at once.

ErrorResponse.description: Every error the API returns has this shape.

FieldError.description: One invalid field in a request.

field.description: The request field, as the client sent it.

position_seconds.description: Where the player is now, in whole seconds. Kept for resuming; never past the end of the video.

invites.description: The invitations still waiting for an answer, newest first.

invited_by.description: Who asked, by name. Empty if they have since left Zeno.

recording_visibility.description:
The recording's visibility after the call: making a link switches a private recording to
`link`, so the client can show it.

email.description: Only owners and admins see the addresses of the others.

PartRequest.description: One more part of a streaming upload: which, how long, and whether it is the last.

size.description: Exactly the part size, unless this is the last part (then 1 up to the part size).

expires_at.description: When the viewing runs out; after that the keys stop.

heartbeat_interval_seconds.description: Send `POST /v1/play/{session}/heartbeat` this often while it plays.

playlist_url.description: Relative to the API's origin; hand it to the HLS player as is.

resume_from_seconds.description: Where the viewer left off, to start from.

watermark.description: Draw this over the video, moving it around, for the whole session.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last.

comments_enabled.description: Whether people watching may leave comments and reactions.

status.description: Read from the video underneath; never stored.

version.description: Changes on every edit; send it back to edit.

view_count.description: All-time views, as of the last flush (see `GET /v1/recordings/{id}/views`).

workspace_id.description: The workspace it is shared with: everyone in it can see and watch it. Absent when it is only yours.

password.description: Not a common password, and not made from the email address.

new_password.description: Not a common password, and not made from the account's email address.

token.description: The one-time token from the emailed link.

ShareView.description:
What a visitor's page needs before anyone presses play. A password-protected link reveals
nothing but that it needs one: not even the title.

expires_at.description: When the link stops working, if it does.

requires_password.description: When true, nothing else about the recording is revealed until the password is given.

status.description: Where the video is in its life; only `ready` can be played.

SharedPlayback.description:
A viewing started through a link. No heartbeat and no resume point: there is no account to
remember either for.

playlist_url.description: Relative to the API's origin; hand it to the HLS player as is.

SignupRole.description: Who a new account is for. Admins are never self-service.

used_bytes.description:
What the person has kept: the size of every video they have uploaded and still have, as it was sent.
Deleted and failed videos are not counted; one still uploading is.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last.

mine.description: Is it the person asking who made it. Those are theirs to take out, to edit and to delete.

status.description: Where it is in its life: `capturing`, `uploading`, `processing`, `ready` or `failed`.

video_id.description:
What to play, when it has a video: `POST /v1/videos/{video_id}/play` starts a viewing for anyone in the
workspace.

token.description: The one-time token from the emailed link.

name.description: What the person is called. Shown beside their comments.

comments_enabled.description: Whether people watching may leave comments and reactions. Turning it off keeps what is there but hides it.

version.description: The version you read. Required, here or in `If-Match`.

visibility.description: Who may watch. Changing it to `private` ends every viewing under way through a link.

parts.description: Parts still to upload, each with a ready-to-use URL.

uploaded.description: Parts storage already holds in full, so a resuming client can skip them.

session_code.description: Short code for this viewing, also in the text. Quote it to support.

text.description: Draw this over the video, moving it around, for the whole viewing.

role.description: What the person asking is in it.

WorkspaceRole.description: What a person is in a workspace.

session.name: zeno_at
session.description: The access cookie set by sign-in. It lasts minutes; `POST /v1/auth/refresh` renews it.

tags.name: account
tags.description: What a signed-in person can see about their own account.

tags.name: playback
tags.description: Watching a video you are allowed to see, signed in: starting a viewing, keeping it alive, ending it. (A share link starts its own, under /v1/s.)

tags.name: workspaces
tags.description: Teams: who is in one, what each may do, and the invitations that bring people in.

tags.name: recordings
tags.description: A person's library, and the links that share its recordings.

tags.name: videos
tags.description: Uploading video. A recording is uploaded while it is made: parts go straight to storage, never through the API.

tags.name: comments
tags.description: What people watching a shared recording say about it: comments and reactions pinned to a moment.

tags.name: share
tags.description: What anyone holding a share link can do. No account, no cookie.
